name: Global Time Echoes: MGEX Multi-GNSS Clock Replication, 2025–2026
description: The Temporal Equivalence Principle (TEP) predicts correlated phase-coherent disturbances in GNSS timekeeping with a spatial correlation length of order thousands of kilometres, an east–west anisotropy, coupling to Earth orbital velocity, and an annual-phase direction near Earth's aphelion velocity tangent. The directed CMB-apex template is anti-phase rather than detected as a rest frame. Papers 1 and 2 examined these signatures in GPS precise point-positioning products from three analysis centres spanning 2000–2025; Paper 3 used raw RINEX single-point positioning.
